newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air NZ to end code share with Canadian.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ to end code share with Canadian.

text.p: Air New Zealand will terminate its arrangement with Canadian Airlines to operate code-share services between Auckland and Toronto and Vancouver on October 26, the airline said on Tuesday.
Air NZ said it planned to announce alternative arrangements by the end of June to maintain its commitment to the Canadian market.
Air NZ said its partnership with Canadian had been terminated following a recent change in its airline alliance arrangements in North America.
On May 15, the first flight under Air NZ's alliance with United Airlines took off.
Air NZ and Canadian have shared capacity on flights that interconnect at Nadi and Honolulu for the past six years.
The arrangement provides four weekly flights between Auckland and Toronto and five weekly flights between Auckland and Vancouver.
